org.name: Excalidraw Whiteboard
org.one_liner: Excalidraw is a virtual collaborative whiteboard tool that lets you easily sketch diagrams that have a hand-drawn feel to them.

facts.claim: Excalidraw is an open source virtual hand-drawn style whiteboard that is collaborative and end-to-end encrypted.
Excalidraw is released under the MIT license.

The Excalidraw editor (npm package) supports an infinite canvas-based whiteboard, dark mode, customizability, image support, shape libraries, localization (i18n) support, exporting to PNG/SVG/clipboard, and an open format saving to `.excalidraw` json files.
The editor provides built-in tools such as rectangle, circle, diamond, arrow, line, free-draw, eraser, arrow-binding, labeled arrows, undo/redo, and zoom/panning.

The showcase app hosted at excalidraw.com features PWA support (offline mode), real-time collaboration, end-to-end encryption, local-first support with browser autosaving, and shareable read-only links.
Excalidraw is integrated by organizations including Google Cloud, Meta, CodeSandbox, Obsidian Excalidraw, Replit, Slite, Notion, and HackerRank.
Excalidraw offers funding and premium options via Open Collective sponsorship and Excalidraw+ (plus.excalidraw.com).

Excalidraw is structured as a monorepo utilizing Yarn workspaces, containing core library packages (common, element, math, utils, fractional-indexing, and excalidraw) and a web application (excalidraw-app).
The monorepo build system uses esbuild for packages and Vite for the web application.
